sourceDisclosures.statement: 원컷 계산 화면이 MapleClassic Wiki Damage 문서를 공식의 출처로 표시한다.
퀘스트 상세가 MapleClassic Wiki의 해당 퀘스트와 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 링크를 출처로 제공한다.
스킬 화면이 Wiki와 테스트 클라이언트 확인 자료를 근거로 밝히며, 미리보기는 클라이언트 이펙트에서 만들었다고 설명한다.
시세 방법 패널은 자체 수집기가 게임 화면에서 읽은 확성기와 자체 거래소의 장비 매물을 출처로 밝힌다. 공통 외부 가격 API를 출처로 밝힌 증거는 없다.

inferences.statement: The observed DB-related screens load own-origin application chunks and a small override endpoint rather than a separate external game-data XHR. Static bundled data or SSR with overrides is a supported architecture hypothesis, not proof of the server upstream.
No browser response from maplestory.io, mapleclassic.wiki or meowdb was observed in these11GGrecords. This does not rule out build-time imports or server-side calls.

reusePaths.path: Follow the attributed MapleClassic Wiki original and its license; independently verify current client facts. Do not use GG distribution files as a substitute for the upstream attribution/license.

Observed own-origin routes identify GG own-data surfaces; captures do not establish a documented reusable public API. Current CLI requests return403. Do not bypass access controls or claim an authenticated owl API was found.
Observed own-origin image files identify local hosting/caching only; original WZ/image provider cannot be inferred from a local filename.

limitations: Capture windows are short selected scenarios, not exhaustive whole-site traffic.
Response bodies were not selected in these historical records, so JSON schemas/row counts cannot be recovered from them.
UI source statements are observed disclosures, not independent audits of server ingestion.
GG own authored content and data organization carry explicit reuse restrictions; the site separately acknowledges licensed CC BY-NC-SA upstream material.
No authenticated owl request/result, session storage, user cookie, API token or private user data was inspected.
